en: A sepia-toned photograph of an ornate cathedral altar, featuring elaborate arches, columns, and religious artwork. The structure is richly decorated and the architectural style is reminiscent of Romanesque or early Gothic church interiors. The image focuses on the main altar area, showing its details and grandeur. There is Hungarian text at the bottom of the postcard.
